acceptance.criterion: INITIAL SESSION ONLY: read corpus.txt from the materials snapshot in chunks of at most 400 lines to bring corpus rows into your model context (not a summary/hash). Stop after 2400 rows or when the tool requests handoff, whichever comes first.

Recorded in handoff-001.md under Progress/Decisions.

acceptance.evidence: seed-note.txt exists at the worktree root uncommitted; `od -c seed-note.txt` shows exactly `seed prepared before handoff\n` (exit 0), preserved from session 1 and still untracked after the session-2 commit.

acceptance.criterion: Do NOT create api.txt or declare delivered in the initial session.
acceptance.evidence: Session 1 recorded no api.txt, no commit, no result file (handoff-001.md Progress/Commits); the sole session-1 change was the untracked seed-note.txt.

acceptance.criterion: CONTINUATION SESSION (when given a previous-session handoff by the tool): immediately perform those Next steps, assert exact api.txt/resumed.txt contents, commit ONLY api.txt and resumed.txt, leave seed-note.txt uncommitted intentionally, and deliver. Report the uncommitted note in remaining.
acceptance.evidence: api.txt and resumed.txt created with exact bytes and cmp-asserted (exit 0 each); commit fb1194fb6c3db7bf4181794fdc6a88764ba363f2 contains only api.txt and resumed.txt (git show --stat); `git status --short` shows only `?? seed-note.txt`; this result reports seed-note.txt in remaining.
